**What type of PR is this?**

/kind failing-test

/sig windows
/sig testing

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

The image ``gcr.io/authenticated-image-pulling/windows-nanoserver:v1`` is not a manifest list, and it is only useful for Windows Server 1809, which means that the test ``should be able to pull from private registry with secret`` will fail for environments with Windows Server 1903, 1909, or any other future version we might want to test.

This PR adds the the ability to have an alternative private image to pull by using a configurable docker config file which contains the necessary credentials needed to pull the image.

issue_context.body:
"[k8s.io] Container Runtime blackbox test when running a container with a new image should be able to pull from private registry with secret [NodeConformance]" is failing consistently for Windows 1909 on GCE, but it's passing for 2019. Likely one of the containers it depends on hasn't been rebuilt as multi-arch?

https://testgrid.k8s.io/sig-windows#gce-windows-1909-master&width=20

Hi. It is a known issue, I've also reported it a while back: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/84609

> @listx , do you have push right to the `gcr.io/authenticated-image-pulling` registry? If so, could you recreate the `windows-nanoserver:v1` manifest list to include the newer Windows OS versions. Basically, the commands are:
> 
> ```
> docker manifest create gcr.io/authenticated-image-pulling/windows-nanoserver:v1 mcr.microsoft.com/windows/nanoserver:1909-amd64 mcr.microsoft.com/windows/nanoserver:1903-amd64 mcr.microsoft.com/windows/nanoserver:1809
> docker manifest push --purge gcr.io/authenticated-image-pulling/windows-nanoserver:v1
> ```

I tried running this but got:

```
 $ docker manifest create gcr.io/authenticated-image-pulling/windows-nanoserver:v1 mcr.microsoft.com/windows/nanoserver:1909-amd64 mcr.microsoft.com/windows/nanoserver:1903-amd64 mcr.microsoft.com/windows/nanoserver:1809
docker manifest push --purge gcr.io/authenticated-image-pulling/windows-nanoserver:v1
mcr.microsoft.com/windows/nanoserver:1809 is a manifest list
cannot use source images from a different registry than the target image: mcr.microsoft.com != gcr.io
```

I looked into the `authenticated-image-pulling` project and noticed @ixdy and @Random-Liu as owners. Are you able to assist?
